profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Healthcare & AI
profile.summary: As a software engineer, I have worked on projects and products, with local and global teammates, leading multiple teams on highly visible, vital initiatives. With experience varying from driving change by transitioning software from on-premise to cloud, designing multi-tenant multi-product platform services, to looking toward the future with AI, I’ve adapted to each need that has arisen, regardless of the tech stack. My focus is on solving problems first- programming is just one tool to help.

volunteerExperiences.description: This year I took courses and joined the Master Gardener program to invest more time into gardening and agriculture for both individual growth and to give back to the community. Spring of 2024 will be the first year.
Yearly, I volunteer at local schools to help elementary and middle school students learn to code.
